messages:
Iris (AE): Zenora wants a 2-week POC next month. Core asks: SAML SSO (IdP + SP flows), SCIM for users+groups (incremental), RBAC mapping with role aliases, and domain verification for tenant-locking. They also want a Dedicated vs Private cost comparison and a short SLA for auth handoff. Need an internal reply by EOD Fri. Any obvious concerns?

Cal (SE): Quick tech list: request IdP metadata (XML or URL), ACS/Assertion Consumer URL we provide, NameID preference (email/persistent), and whether they need encrypted assertions. Ask which attribute contains groups (groups vs memberOf). We can support Signed Assertions RSA-SHA256 by default.

Ana (Security): From the vendor questionnaire: require signed assertions (RSA-SHA256), SCIM over TLS1.2+, SCIM auth via OAuth2 client_credentials with scoped tokens, token rotation every 90 days, and audit logs retained 180 days. Legal will want SOC2 attestation and DPA for Private installs.

Diego (Eng): SCIM details: we support full import + incremental (delta) syncs. Default rate limit 50 req/min; Dedicated POC can bump this temporarily. Note: nested groups require flattening on the IdP side or we supply a small helper script. ExternalId is authoritative for user identity. Example SCIM user we accept: ```json
{"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],"userName":"lee@zenora.com","externalId":"z-321"}```

Omar (Pricing): For pricing I need MAU and token estimates. We can offer a 30-day POC credit and a short Dedicated vs Private comparator showing committed GPU vs management fee. Can someone confirm ballpark numbers?

Iris (AE): Zenora estimated ~650 MAUs during POC, ~2.2M tokens/month, and ~900 groups. They may scale to 3k MAUs if POC succeeds. They asked if tenant-lock supports multiple roots and subdomains.

Cal (SE): Tenant verification options: DNS TXT proof per domain (we provide token), or a domain-admin signed email if DNS edits not possible. For multiple roots we issue multiple tokens. We'll include a DNS TXT template in the quickstart.

DeployBot: scim-connector/v3.4 deployed to staging  scim create/update smoke tests passed 

Ana (Security): Potential blocker: Zenora flagged EU-only residency for identity data. If confirmed, propose EU Dedicated or Private and Legal DPA addendum. Lead time ~2 business days for legal signoff. Also prepare least-privilege SCIM scopes (scim:users.write scim:groups.write) in docs.

Diego (Eng): Private install checklist (short): allow outbound to control-plane on 443, exchange mTLS certs, and provide maintenance windows for upgrades. We'll provide a runbook and a minimal network diagram.

Omar (Pricing): Action: I'll draft a POC quote with the credit and side-by-side costs; need MAU/token confirmation by EOD tomorrow to lock rates.

Cal (SE): Action: I'll request IdP metadata + a sample SAML response and ask for a sample SCIM user/group payload. I'll assemble a SAML+SCIM quickstart and an RBAC role-alias template (CSV).

Iris (AE): Thanks team  I'll confirm EU residency with the customer and schedule a 30-min technical sync for Wed 10am PT. Will loop everyone in.
